title: Interface-first runtime executor proof and scanner ownership trace

checks.name: upstream interface defines typed request, closed judgment, and proof
proof carries ordered derivation stages, source coverage, and result count
runtime boundary validates closure and proof without semantic re-derivation
authority composes the existing resource, route-response, and model derivations
runtime executor delegates to authority then validates the returned contract
concrete authority composition is outside scanner
scanner facade consumes executor and does not select the concrete authority
tests cover delegation and mismatched source-coverage rejection

openFrontiers.note: Orchestrator still calls derivation aggregation implemented under scanner/subscanners/request-deriver.
Action/response/group assembly still mixes domain derivation and descriptor construction.
Syntax-to-AST construction is expected; domain inference/classification ownership still needs rule-by-rule trace.
